description: Blend-mode sweep (additive): per texture set (s0 LinearDodge, s1 Subtract, s2 InverseSubtract, s3 Difference, s4 Exclusion, s5 SignedAddition, s6 Screen, s7 LinearBurn) a lower fill with the authored 16-bit fields A (RGB) / grey A and an upper fill with fields B / grey B in the set's mode, on eight user channels covering the formats RGB16, sRGB8, RGB8, RGB16F, L16 and RGB32F at upper opacities 1, 0.5 and 0.25 (04 section 3). Sets without a mode keep the empty stack.
